title: Fix non-functional button and select dropdown in AdminCommentsTab

requirements.text: Fix the button at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/main[1]/div[1]/div[3]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/button[1] in AdminCommentsTab to properly handle click events and create the intended comment list when clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the button triggers comment list creation
Loading state is shown during creation
Success feedback is displayed after creation
New list appears in the dropdown after creation
Error messages are shown if creation fails

requirements.text: Fix the select dropdown at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/main[1]/div[1]/div[3]/div[1]/div[2]/div[2]/div[1]/select[1] in AdminCommentsTab to properly handle change events and trigger the appropriate action when a new option is selected
acceptanceCriteria: Select dropdown responds to change events
Changing selection triggers the appropriate action
Selected value is properly stored in component state
Dependent UI elements update based on selection
Error handling is in place for failed actions

constraints: Only modify the AdminCommentsTab component and related hooks
Do not change the backend schema or main.mo actor
nonGoals: Changing the overall admin panel layout
Adding new features beyond fixing the specified elements
